comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Treasure Hidden in the Maze Memorial Album. This item drops randomly from treasure chests within the Labyrinth endless dungeon. Stats:

Evasion +1
5000 fame to equip, unisex

Beware: if you have activated the two Treasure Hunt themes related to this dungeon, either The Fall of Atlantis or Ancient High Technology, then this item will never drop as the themes change which items become obtainable from the Labyrinth dungeon's chests.

Lastly, it can be upgraded via Transmutation Alchemy into Mycenaean Soldier's Foot Armour EX -- appropriately, with the Age effect (Mythical Era) EX Effect.

Happy deepseeking to you. Cheers.
